card.who: Rita's back-room hand. He lifts, carries, fixes radios and sells what does not go in the window. He owes Mickey's book thirty pounds.
card.life: Fixes sets and stereos in the back. Will find a man a cosh or a flick knife for cash and no receipt.
card.fire: Reckons it was the insurance. Reckons everyone reckons that.
card.rivals: Would work for Cammack if Rita ever let him go.
